description: Interface describing a blob storage entry.

dateCreated.description: The date/time when the entry was created. json-ld namespace:schema

dateModified.description: The date/time when the entry was modified. json-ld namespace:schema

blobSize.description: The size of the data in the blob. json-ld type:schema:Integer

blobHash.description: The hash of the data in the blob. json-ld namespace:twin-common

encodingFormat.description: The mime type for the blob. json-ld namespace:schema

isEncrypted.description: Indicates if the blob is encrypted. json-ld type:schema:Boolean

compression.description: The type of compression used for the blob, if not set it is not stored with compression. json-ld type:schema:Text

metadata.description: The metadata for the blob as JSON-LD. json-ld id

blob.description: The blob in base64 format, included if the includeContent flag was set in the request. json-ld type:schema:Text
